name: github
purpose: Repositories, issues and pull requests on github.com
guide:
The GitHub REST API (https://docs.github.com/rest) and GraphQL API, as the person.

```sh
curl -s https://api.github.com/user
curl -s 'https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:OWNER/REPO+is:open'
```

Private repositories need the `repo` scope, which GitHub grants only with changes: the person allows changes to give it.
